headline: Freddie Mac: U.S. 30-Year Mortgage Rate Falls to 7.32%
summary: The benchmark 30-year fixed-rate mortgage fell to 7.32% from 7.40% last week, marking the first pullback since late August, according to Freddie Mac.
why: U.S. mortgage rates directly affect residential borrowing costs, housing turnover, and construction sector activity.

impacts.name: US Real Estate
impacts.why: A slight decline in borrowing costs provides marginal relief to prospective homebuyers, though borrowing costs remain elevated.
